title: On CPU Physics and CPU Cycles
summary: An in-depth exploration of CPU physical fundamentals, explaining how CPU cycles work at the hardware level and the physics behind processor operations, targeted at developers seeking to understand low-level computing principles for performance optimization.
problem_solved: Helps developers understand the physical constraints and cycle mechanics of CPUs to write more performant code.
why_valuable: Provides fundamental knowledge about CPU operation that enables developers to make better architectural decisions and optimization choices at the hardware level.
